limits: No independent GPU forward or experimental rerun. Actual runtime attributes and mask/edge consumption are audited from frozen implementation assertions and per-layer invocation records.
The first large-model discovery batch is a fixed n16 pilot. Cross-size paired confirmation and Llama70 stages are pending until complete.
Raw attention mass sums all heads; it is neither a normalized cross-checkpoint scale nor a causal mediation estimate.
Candidate two-label accuracy, full-output argmax, confidence margins and both private directions are retained separately.
Historical TF32 floor failures contain zero scientific rows and remain execution failures, not negative outcomes.
Resident device-hours are cumulative per worker; scientific stage timer totals exclude intervening protocol overhead and cannot replace final continuous-residency accounting.
